body.prose:
A component declares itself in its own module, beside its code: what it is, the types it takes and the kinds of slot it draws in, by their names, what it is given, the settings it takes, each said in prose with its shape as a type declares its fields, and the reads it makes beyond what it is handed. The birth checks every name and that the declaration is well formed; the engine checks that each declared setting is said as a field; and what a slot gives is checked against the settings before the component draws. A component is then given what its slot reads, typed as its type declares, the bodies made by the build from the field's own types with each field's prose as its comment, and its reads answered with the shape their form gives.

Its reach is a ceiling: it reaches what it was handed, what that references and is an instance of, and what its own declared reads give back; reading a holon it was handed opens nothing further. It reads only by the forms it declares, each read one form and nothing beside it, and opens slots only for what it reaches. Anything else is refused by name, and every query and every list it opens is copied before it is judged, so what is judged is what is used. The reach is each slot's own: unlike OpenLight's, which narrows from parent to child with grants, a child's starts again from what its slot reads. This is a ceiling among components in one page, which keeps each honest about what it looks at; it is not isolation, for code in the page can reach everything the page can, which is why only glass's own components and the home's are run until components can run apart.

A component is a pure function of what it is given and of the field: it draws again whole when what it read changes. What must last across a drawing, as where a pane is scrolled, lives in the slot's host, which stays while what is in it is drawn again; a pane scrolls within itself, its top fading once scrolled.

A list, a gathering and the field say nothing of what their items are, so a component that takes a type for its items, such as a timeline of a record's entries, draws there only where a slot names it; otherwise one that takes nothing in particular is found. A full slot never draws in full a holon that a slot around it already draws in full; there it shows its face, so nothing stands inside itself without end. And a component a slot names that is not run, or cannot draw there, is said to be so in the slot, as OpenLight's "not admitted here", rather than quietly replaced, except where the nesting guard, not the slot, changed what was asked.

*Reach, settings and typed bodies from OpenLight's view, read the same day; the session's reading of where glass went against it, mended after three fresh readings. The nesting guard adds to the slot contract, which is provisional. Not yet built, having no use yet: acts, a component committing or launching with the reach facts that say what it may write; and offers, what a holder gives everything beneath it to bind by type, which wait for something that must trickle. Keeping a component's own state between drawings, as OpenLight's update does, is held open.*
body.title: What a component may do
